identity: A labeled form with text fields, password fields, or a text area, and an in-app action button on forms that require saving or signing in.

scenarios.name: single
scenarios.screen: One labeled text field is empty.
never: A text picker is open.
A second field is shown.
Text is already entered in the field.

arrangements.text: The label sits above the field.
The label sits to the left of the field.

scenarios.name: transform
scenarios.screen: One labeled text field is empty; the requested text change appears in the task instruction.
never: The transformed answer is already in the field.
A separate source-text field is shown.
A transformation menu is open.

arrangements.text: The label sits above the field.
The label sits to the left of the field.

scenarios.hint: Do not fill in the transformed answer.

scenarios.name: password
scenarios.screen: Two labeled, empty, masked fields ask for a password and its confirmation.
never: Either password is visible as plain text.
A generated-password panel is open.
A third password box is shown.

arrangements.text: The password field sits above the confirmation field, with each label above its box.
The two fields sit side by side, with each label above its box.

scenarios.name: login
scenarios.screen: An empty username or email field sits with an empty masked password field and an in-app Sign in button.
never: A signed-in account panel is shown.
An incorrect-credentials message is visible.
The password is shown as plain text.
A confirmation-password field is shown.

arrangements.text: The username or email field sits above the password field, with Sign in below both.
The two fields sit in one row, with Sign in below the row.

scenarios.hint: Show empty username/email and password fields matching the requested identifier type; no successful login state.

scenarios.name: multi
scenarios.screen: A form typically shows four labeled fields in form order. Scored fields start empty; a disabled look-alike, when present, holds a fixed value. Forms that require saving show an in-app Save button.
never: Twelve editable fields are shown.
A date picker or other picker is open.
An error message from a save attempt is visible.
A tab or collapsible section hides part of the form.

arrangements.text: The fields run down one column in form order, with Save below the last field.
The fields occupy two columns in form order, with Save below the columns.

scenarios.name: textarea
scenarios.screen: An empty labeled multi-line text area is shown. Some forms also show an empty one-line field or a character counter.
never: The requested lines are already entered.
A separate box is shown for every requested line.
A file attachment tray is open.

arrangements.text: The label sits above the text area, with a counter below it when one is present.
A one-line companion field sits above the text area, with each label beside its field.

scenarios.name: copy
scenarios.screen: A labeled source field already contains text, and a labeled destination field is empty. Some forms include one more field to fill and an in-app Save button.
never: The destination already contains the copied value.
A clipboard history panel is open.
The source value appears only in the instruction.

arrangements.text: The source field sits above the destination field, with Save below the fields when present.
The source field sits to the left of the destination field, with Save below them when present.

scenarios.name: validation-fix
scenarios.screen: Every field is filled. One field shows an inline validation error from a failed save, and an in-app Save or Update button is available.
never: All fields are empty.
Two fields show inline errors.
A successful-save message is visible.
An error dialog covers the form.

arrangements.text: The fields run down one column, with the error directly below its field and the action button below the form.
The fields occupy two columns, with the error directly below its field and the action button below both columns.

scenarios.name: sections
scenarios.screen: A settings form has several labeled fields holding current values across tabs or collapsible sections. The first section is open, the others are closed, and an in-app Save button is shown.
never: Every section is open at once.
A non-first section is open initially.
All current values are blank.
A separate save button is shown inside every section.

arrangements.text: Tabs sit above the fields of the first section, with Save below the visible fields.
Section headers run down the form; the first expands to show its fields, with Save below the sections.

scenarios.name: complete
scenarios.screen: A partly filled form shows required and optional fields, with some required fields empty and an in-app Save button. A contact card beside the form supplies the missing values when the task uses a card.
never: Every required field is already filled.
The optional fields with no source data are filled.
A field picker is open.
The contact card has editable fields.

arrangements.text: The form sits to the left of the contact card, with Save below the form.
The contact card sits to the left of the form, with Save below the form.
The form stands alone, with Save below its fields.
